displayName: Context Manager Service Perimeter Dry Run Egress Policy

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Perimeter
fields.help: The name of the Service Perimeter to add this resource to.

fields.label: Title
fields.help: Human readable title.

fields.label: Egress From
Identities
fields.help: Identities can be an individual user, service account, Google group, or third-party identity.

fields.label: Identity Type
fields.help: Specifies the type of identities that are allowed access to outside the perimeter.

fields.label: Source Restriction
fields.help: Whether to enforce traffic restrictions based on 'sources' field.

fields.label: Sources
Access Level
fields.help: An AccessLevel resource name that allows resources outside the ServicePerimeter to be accessed from the inside.

fields.label: Resource
fields.help: A Google Cloud resource that is allowed to egress the perimeter.

fields.label: Psc Endpoint
Forwarding Rule
fields.help: The full resource name of the global forwarding rule that identifies a Private Service Connect endpoint.
A Private Service Connect endpoint that is allowed to access data outside the perimeter.
Sources that this EgressPolicy authorizes access from.
Defines conditions on the source of a request causing this 'EgressPolicy' to apply.

fields.label: Egress To
External Resources
fields.help: A list of external resources that are allowed to be accessed.

fields.label: Resources
fields.help: A list of resources, currently only projects in the form 'projects/<projectnumber>', that match this to stanza.

fields.label: Roles
fields.help: A list of IAM roles that represent the set of operations that the sources specified in the corresponding 'EgressFrom' are allowed to perform.

fields.label: Operations
Service Name
fields.help: The name of the API whose methods or permissions the 'IngressPolicy' or 'EgressPolicy' want to allow.

fields.label: Method Selectors
Method
fields.help: Value for 'method' should be a valid method name for the corresponding 'serviceName' in 'ApiOperation'.

fields.label: Permission
fields.help: Value for permission should be a valid Cloud IAM permission for the corresponding 'serviceName' in 'ApiOperation'.
API methods or permissions to allow.
A list of 'ApiOperations' that this egress rule applies to.
Defines the conditions on the 'ApiOperation' and destination resources that cause this 'EgressPolicy' to apply.
